blind_answer.reason: Subagents do not inherit the coordinator's context, and they share no memory between invocations, so the prior account review findings must be passed explicitly in the spawning prompt (1.3-K2, 1.3-S1). Option A is wrong because parallel subagents cannot see each other's results. Option B rests on a false claim about shared memory. Option C does not supply the missing data.
